title: Transmission Fluid Level Check
introduction: This check covers the MT82 manual transmission in the engine configurations listed on this page. I treat the fill opening as a measuring reference, not an invitation to fill until oil spills out: the drawing shows the correct fluid surface below the opening. Keep the car level, adjust the fluid to the illustrated range, then reinstall and torque the plug.

items.name: Prevent an unexpected start
items.detail: If equipped, disable remote start through the Central Display under Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup before working around or underneath the vehicle. Otherwise, a remote start could cause personal injury or death. Switch the ignition off and remove the key to prevent another person starting the engine during service; an accidental start can cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Protection and fluid handling
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection, and wear protective gloves when handling sharp or pointed parts; failing to do so can cause serious personal injury. Read the transmission fluid’s material safety information before using it, because improper handling can present a health hazard and cause serious personal injury. Review the applicable [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189) before starting.

items.name: Locate the lifting points
items.detail: Use the triangular marks stamped into the body or frame to identify the lifting locations along the side sills, toward the front and rear of the vehicle. The close-up views are available in [Jacking and Lifting - Overview](#/document/G1663631). Lifting elsewhere can let the vehicle shift or fall and cause serious personal injury.

items.name: If using a jack
items.detail: Work on a hard, level surface. Check that the jack can carry the vehicle’s weight, including cargo and modifications. Set the parking brake and block every wheel remaining on the ground. After raising the car, support it with floor stands while keeping it level. Never go underneath a car supported only by a jack: it can lower unexpectedly, and unintended vehicle movement can cause serious personal injury or death. The supplied emergency tire-changing jack must not be used for this job, because doing so can damage the vehicle.

items.name: If using a hoist
items.detail: Check that the hoist can carry the vehicle, including cargo and modifications, and position its arms at the locations in the lifting reference. Incorrect arm placement can cause unintended movement and serious personal injury or death. Never use the engine to power the drive wheels unless all drive wheels are clear of the ground. Check drive-on lift clearance before driving onto it to prevent underbody damage. Position adapters and forks clear of suspension, exhaust, steering linkage, mounting brackets and stabilizer mounting brackets, if equipped; also protect the axle and rear cover from contact damage. Never apply jack pressure to either bumper, because the covers will be damaged.

items.name: Adjustment and tightening equipment
items.detail: Have the listed fluid suction gun available to add or withdraw fluid, and torque equipment suitable for tightening the fill plug to the value in the installation step.

items.name: Use the matching fluid specification
items.detail: Use Motorcraft® Dual Clutch Transmission Fluid / XT-11-QDC (WSS-M2C200-D2), identified in the linked [Specifications](#/document/G1687313). The table also contains materials for other service operations; those entries are not interchangeable fluid choices. Its transmission-additive footnote applies only after synchronizer replacement. For this level adjustment, use the illustrated fluid-height range rather than adding the table’s entire capacity to a transmission that already contains fluid.

edits.why: The equipment table identifies the suction gun used to control the amount of fluid through the fill opening.

edits.text: NOTE: Keep the vehicle level while checking and adjusting the transmission fluid.
edits.why: A tilted case changes the fluid height at the opening. I want the gearbox giving an honest reading, rather than acting like a spirit level on a crooked shelf.

edits.text: Prepare safe underside access using [Jacking and Lifting - Overview](#/document/G1663631) (100-02 Jacking and Lifting, Description and Operation). Maintain the vehicle’s level position.
edits.why: The lifting reference identifies the triangular marks at the front and rear lifting areas along each side sill. Correct support provides access to the transmission without compromising either vehicle stability or the fluid-height reading.

edits.text: Locate the fill plug highlighted on the side of the transmission case in the drawing, then remove it.
edits.why: Removing this plug exposes the opening used both to adjust the fluid and to reference its height. The arrow distinguishes it from the surrounding case fasteners.

edits.text:
Compare the fluid surface with the lower edge of the fill opening using the range shown in the illustration. Use the General Equipment: Fluid Suction Gun to add fluid if the surface is too low or withdraw fluid if it is too high, until it sits within that range.
Refer to: [Specifications](#/document/G1687313) (308-03A Manual Transmission - 6-Speed Manual Transmission – MT82, Specifications).
edits.why: The cutaway shows an intentional gap between the opening’s lower edge and the fluid surface. Filling to the point of overflow would miss that target. The suction gun lets you correct the level in either direction; the linked specifications identify the appropriate fluid.

edits.text:
Once the fluid level is within the illustrated range, reinstall the fill plug.
Torque: 26 lb.ft (35 Nm)
edits.why: This closes the opening after the adjustment. Use the specified tightening torque to complete the plug installation.

editorialRevision.scope: Requirements-only transcription of applicable fluid/product specification from complete trusted G1687313 table; actual adjustment/level/torque actions untouched. Full prior independent review retained; focused approval pending.
